title: Owner decisions taken — the eight directed improvements (2026-11-14)

source.label: X1 project brief — owner's directed improvements (bolded)

rows.decision: Implement now — build the price-snapshot store
rows.what_was_built: Opening/closing store for every originated market (56 rows), CLV-ready schema, provenance and verification columns per cell. Openings blank (no source records them), closings recorded from the fingerprinted mirror flagged UNVERIFIED until a licensed feed is attached (Q-02).

rows.decision: Implement now — build the verified results feed
rows.what_was_built: 137 completed 2026 games (weeks 1-10) with final scores read from nfl.com and re-verified by standings arithmetic (32 clubs x W/L/T/PF/PA = 160 checks, all pass) plus a 137/137 third-party cross-match. Backtest and ROI grading now has a verified results source.

rows.decision: Implement now — originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.what_was_built: Origination order is enforced in the builder: sides for all 14 games, then totals, then moneylines; the build fails if a later market class is emitted before an earlier one is complete.

rows.decision: Implement now — fair line / market line / difference as separate columns
rows.what_was_built: Every originated-market row publishes model_fair_line, market_line and difference as three columns with one defined sign convention (difference = fair - market; moneylines in win-probability points).

rows.decision: Implement now — separate signal from staking in the leaderboard
rows.what_was_built: Leaderboard split into a SIGNAL block (flat-stake grading: hit rate, mean CLV, CLV t-stat, edge at close — promotion/demotion read this only) and a STAKING block (ROI at rule, drawdown, growth — reporting only). A lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal.

rows.decision: Implement now — track the depth of the replacement
rows.what_was_built: Replacement-depth store: 78 starter slots with a game status, each recording which string replaces the starter (68 x 2nd string, 1 x 3rd string, 9 with no replacement listed) on offense, defense and special teams; every row re-verified against the club chart and the injury report.

rows.decision: Implement now — correlations from official numbers only, n published
rows.what_was_built: Official-only correlation store: 3,570 pairs over 85 NFL.com metrics x 32 clubs, every value carrying n and p; independent recomputation agrees with the published pipeline table 905/905. No third-party-derived value is published as a correlation.

rows.decision: Implement now — define the demotion gate
rows.what_was_built: Demotion gate D1-D5 defined with concrete thresholds: CLV decay, drawdown, hit-rate decay, data-integrity trips, and the re-promotion rule (50 new graded bets, no reuse of pre-demotion data). Closes question Q-26 and unblocks gate G-13.

note: The other suggestions on the board (S-03, S-07, S-08, S-10 to S-13, S-15 to S-19) remain proposed and untouched: the suggestion board exists so each is chosen before it is built. Nothing outside this list was implemented.

verification.note: Each row links to the artefact that implements it.
